speaker: Emma
text: My name is Emma, and I opened this bookshop ten years ago. The building used to be a bakery, and sometimes I think you can still smell the fresh bread.

speaker: Emma
text: When I first moved here, I wanted to create a place where people could slow down and discover something unexpected.

speaker: Emma
text: We do not just sell books. Every Saturday, we host a reading group. People from all over the neighborhood come to share their favorite stories.

speaker: Emma
text: My favorite part of the job is recommending a book to someone and seeing them return to tell me how much they loved it.

speaker: Emma
text: Running a small business is not always easy, but these little connections make it worthwhile. Next month, we are adding a small corner where visitors can enjoy a cup of tea.
